portInfo.description: Kuşadası is a beach-resort town whose cruise port, run by Global Ports Holding as Ege Port, exists largely because of Ephesus, about 20 minutes inland. The ancient city is one of the best-preserved classical sites in the Mediterranean (editorial). The port's two finger piers (1,297 m) can take Oasis-class ships. For you, the key choice is a ship's excursion versus a taxi deal. The port lists fixed-price round-trip taxis to Ephesus, the House of the Virgin Mary, Şirince and the national park.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Ephesus (Library of Celsus, theatre, Terrace Houses). 2–2.5 h.
House of the Virgin Mary, 25 min by taxi. 45 min.
Şirince, a hill village 30 min away. 75 min.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Agree the taxi's fixed round-trip price and waiting time before you set off. The port says you pay at the end. Get the driver's number and the meeting point at the exit.
